description: the moored cylinder of fnpf_3d_amr_decay_sub with all six DOFs free in regular waves (H 0.04 m, T 1 s) on a refined patch without subcycling (G 7 0): per stage the psi_0 solve and at the first stage the six unit-mode solves on all grids. The psi solves keep the rows and the preconditioner of the phi solve before them (fnpf_amr::lap_same), stop at the half step of BiCGStab (reefamr_bicgstab halfexit), and the roll, pitch and yaw modes start from their last solution moved to the new centre of gravity (fnpf_6DOF::mode_shift on all grids); REEF3D_FNPF_6DOF compared.
covers: fnpf_amr::lap_core: the half-step exit of the psi solves
fnpf_amr::lap_same with six unit modes per step
